name: A Person's Worth
description:
Worthy of salvation, despite the fall. 
<Leak Marker> Randomly selects a deployable low-ground tile and generates a Leak Source

abilities.text: Not visible normally; increases ATK when it reveals itself.

Periodically fires a ring of beams that cause the first allied unit hit to take continuous True damage for a period of time, with closer units taking higher damage more frequently. When a beam hits a target, it accelerates the process of revealing the source.
Reveals itself after some time, firing more beams more frequently; leaves the field some time after revealing itself.

Revealed when an Operator is deployed on its tile or the four adjacent tiles; during this period, beams only affect the earliest-deployed Operator nearby; leaves the field after some time and gives all allied Operators SP.

Has a shield that protects against Physical and Arts damage. Shield is broken after taking a certain amount of damage in a single hit. Gains greatly increased DEF when shield is active, while RES is reduced. Shield is created when affected by a <Leak Source>.
Locks on to allied units, continuously dealing Arts damage and stealing a portion of the target's ATK.
Recovers HP when affected by a <Leak Source>.
Splits when first affected by a <Leak Source>.
Creates a <Leak Source> nearby when defeated.
Death deals a large amount of Physical damage to surrounding units
Continuously moves toward the nearest <Leak Source>; increases in size and deals increased damage on death for each <Leak Source> touched, up to a maximum of 2 times.
Next attack hits three times when affected by a <Leak Source>.
